schema_interpretation.exact_sets: required_fields on closed envelopes and codec variants are exact, not optional unions. Variant source symbols retain discriminant/value validation. Source-expression entries are source syntax, not evaluated defaults.
schema_interpretation.record_defaults: domain.json.fields admits omitted schema_version as 1 only when versioned; _fields_v2 accepts 1/2 and requires v2 additions only for 2. Unknown record keys are refused.
schema_interpretation.producer_sites: literal construction sites preserve all field expressions including dynamic constants. They are supporting provenance, not complete schemas: normalized_envelopes and decoder sites govern later additions.
schema_interpretation.runtime_execution: inventory is static AST/source inspection, not actual CLI help execution or proof that all listed command paths were exercised
schema_interpretation.test_owners: module ownership references only; Rust tests are unimplemented, not inferred from old test counts

historical_compatibility.old_schema2: authenticate completed history with explicit LegacyAdmissionPlan and LegacyReleaseSelectionPlan; completed authenticated journal replay may return already_applied
historical_compatibility.new_schema3: PortfolioAdmissionPlan / PortfolioReleaseSelectionPlan are actual current source names for handover AdmissionPlan / ReleaseSelectionPlan
forbidden: relabeling old signed objects as schema3
evidence or authority pooled across contexts
old approvals reused against changed predecessor
renaming historical refs, namespaces or checker identities
historical_compatibility.authored_design_identity: design-v3:<sha256>; historical unprefixed material hashes retain original projection
historical_compatibility.retained_reads: pinned retained release queries may finish after head advances; stale mutations require re-preparation and approval

signature_contract.wire_signature: 128 hexadecimal characters; decoder accepts either hex case; writer emits lowercase

canonical.standard_claim: existing Python JSON profile, not RFC 8785
preserve: exact integer values and decimal representation

signature_contract.intrinsic_plan_identity: SHA256 canonical envelope after deleting outer id and nested plan.id; no self-hash cycle
signature_contract.approval_authority: trusted policy key permits declared use and every context use; authored actor is provenance, not a release approver
signature_contract.golden_bytes_status: source profile frozen here; cross-host v2/v3 golden signed-byte fixtures and verification are P02/WF03 obligations, not executed

numeric_contract.semantic_values: arbitrary-precision Python integers / Lean natural numbers; do not narrow to u64/i64 or IEEE-754
numeric_contract.wire_naturals: integer, not Boolean, nonnegative; applies to observation/evaluation times, TTL duration, offsets and limits at semantic boundary
numeric_contract.operational_limits: RPC integer bounds are separate per-field schemas, not a semantic machine-integer restriction
numeric_contract.decoder_profile: Python JSON integer digit acceptance depends on interpreter limits; no universal fixed digit threshold is claimed. P02 must declare matched resource bounds or explicitly version differences; reject overflow rather than truncate.
numeric_contract.ordering: ordered model lists remain ordered; deterministic SQL order and canonical arrays cannot be replaced by hash-map order
numeric_contract.model_boundary_distinction: Direct Python Ttl construction type-checks integer seconds; strict reference dec_ttl uses nat and rejects negative values. Match the actual external wire, not a broader internal constructor.

transport_contract.framing: sequential bounded UTF-8 JSONL, JSON-RPC 2.0, no batches
transport_contract.reference_request_id: nonempty Unicode scalar string; empty ID rejected in core and workflow dispatch
transport_contract.uncertain_mutation: after invocation, mutation-classified errors have exit_code=null, complete=false, generation=null, outcome=unknown; rejection is not proof no write occurred
transport_contract.json_cli: payload only; errors use schema1 envelope; diagnostics do not contaminate JSON stdout

exit_codes.0: successful command result, subject to explicit completeness
exit_codes.3: citation unverifiable or incomplete bounded RPC result

authored_design_contract.workflow_version: omitted means historical 2; only 2 and 3 supported
authored_design_contract.unknown_sections: preserve losslessly, including custom frontmatter, CRLF, fenced examples and citations
rules: design acceptance may precede repository creation
binding requires resolved source/target and accepted design
rebind clears landed authority even for same target; old-target gates stay history
final applied/verified records require supersession, never in-place retarget/reopen
v2 custom binding-like fields remain material, never inferred authority

producer_provenance.name: knowledge toolchain artifact
producer_provenance.semantic_sources: sorted semantics/*.py filenames mapped to SHA256 exact bytes
producer_provenance.tool_versions: Python platform.python_version; distribution cryptography; native dolt version stdout stripped; Git --version stdout stripped
producer_provenance.identity: SHA256 canonical JSON artifact, bound as plan.toolchain and manifest.toolchain_artifact
producer_provenance.limitations: knowledge artifact hashes semantics only, unlike complete graph package provenance; native version string is not executable digest

producer_provenance.name: graph generation input manifest
producer_provenance.source_hashes: complete installed kctx Python modules, including unimported modules; loaded modules use actual locations; missing source/distribution metadata is an error
producer_provenance.identity: SHA256 existing canonical JSON encoding, stored as input_digest
producer_provenance.dolt_version: first multiline match ^dolt version \S+ from native output; upgrade warning excluded; not strict parser/executable-content admission
producer_provenance.rust_obligation: record Writfold producer/compiler/dependency/native executable identities truthfully in an explicitly versioned new envelope; never claim Python toolchain provenance

producer_provenance.name: semantic receipt context
producer_provenance.contract: receipt context, result, computed dependencies and expiry must match actual named-checker execution; caller values do not manufacture capability; retain historical identity

producer_provenance.name: authored observation provenance
producer_provenance.contract: captured Git identity must agree with source revision; legacy/uncaptured cannot claim capture; duplicate/self-derived observations rejected; worktree identity and dependence roots retain acquisition scope

remaining_delivery_boundaries: No Rust product parity or gate pass is asserted by this inventory.
P02 must produce cross-host signed-byte goldens and reviewed intentional wire changes, if any.
Operational replica support, bootstrap canonicalization, tolerant context incident readers, unborn restore, native diagnostics and managed locks remain in remaining-work.json.
Production corpus and additional hardware-bound cost budgets remain unfrozen; evaluation-profile.json freezes only actual synthetic inputs and existing thresholds.
